definition: Statement on Auditing Standards No. 70 was a U.S. auditing standard for reporting on controls at service organizations relevant to their customers' financial reporting.
entry_text: Statement on Auditing Standards No. 70 was a U.S. auditing standard for reporting on controls at service organizations relevant to their customers' financial reporting.
example: An auditor reading an archived file distinguishes a report issued under SAS 70 from its later reporting frameworks.
label: Statement on Auditing Standards No. 70
sense_note: Historical standard; do not treat it as current guidance.
